about.desc: Bluetooth fingerprint authentication: unlock the screen by fingerprint, dual-host management, OTA firmware update. Screen unlock is built on a Credential Provider.
about.name: About immurok
about.ota.desc: Automatically check for the latest firmware online and update the device over the air. Make sure the device has more than 50% battery remaining before updating.
about.title: About
device.dual.desc: One device can be linked to two computers. Touch the device's switch fingerprint to move between them.
device.dual.desc_offline: This PC is still linked to a device that is not connected right now. Unlinking here only clears the local link data, so you can link a new device.
device.pair.hint: Linking asks you to press the button on the bottom of the device; if the device is already linked to another computer, touch an enrolled finger first, then press the button.
device.pair.hint.fresh: No computer is linked to the device yet, so linking takes one step: press the button on the bottom of the device once (it blinks white while waiting).
device.pair.need_connect: Device not connected. Add and connect the immurok device in Windows Settings › Bluetooth & devices first. If it is currently connected to the other computer, disconnect it there or move that computer out of range.
device.pair.slot_hint: The device is already linked to another computer, so this PC will take Host {0}. Linking takes two steps: ① touch an enrolled finger on the device; ② then press the button on the bottom.
device.pair.slots_full: Both host slots on the device are taken. Unlink one of them (hover a slot row below) before linking this PC.
device.pair.stale: The slot this PC occupies on the device (Host {0}) is empty, so the local link is void — it was most likely unlinked from the other computer. Linking again replaces it.
device.pair.stale_reset: The device no longer holds a link for this PC (it may have been reset). Linking again replaces the stale local data.
device.subtitle: Bluetooth connection, linking & two hosts
enroll.title: Enroll fingerprint
features.agent.hint: Require a fingerprint before an AI agent runs a command via imk run --agent.
features.lock.hint: Hold your finger on the sensor for ~2s to lock the screen. Off by default.
features.otp.hint: Read TOTP codes from the device, in the client and via imk get.
features.ssh.hint: Sign SSH/git operations with keys held on the device, authorized by fingerprint.
features.subtitle: Turn individual capabilities on or off
features.unlock.hint: Submit your saved password to unlock the lock screen when your fingerprint matches.
features.unlock.nopassword: ⚠ Login password not configured — this feature stays inactive. Set it on the Settings page.
fp.auth.desc: For unlock and authorization, up to 5 (slots 0-4).
fp.switch.desc: Dedicated to switching between two hosts (slot 5); not used for unlock. Once enrolled, press this fingerprint on the device to switch to the other host.
fp.title: Fingerprint management
fpauth.head: Touch the fingerprint sensor
fpauth.title: Fingerprint required
inject.capture.failed: Capture failed — didn't land on a valid control (or landed on this locator). Try again, dropping right on the password box.
inject.capture.hint: Drag the crosshair onto the target app's password box and release. Keep the target window visible and not covered by this window.
inject.del.title: Delete item
inject.f.name: Name
inject.need.capture: Locate a target password box first.
inject.need.name: Please enter a name.
inject.pick.hint: Left-click to confirm · right-click or Esc to cancel
inject.presets.desc: Known apps ship with immurok — add one and you only need to enter your own password. The app identity is pinned by package family name and code signature, so it survives app updates.
inject.subtitle: Locate a target app's password box and bind a dedicated password. On a fingerprint touch it is filled into the matching app.
inject.title: Custom
inject.warn.notpassword: Heads up: the located element isn't a password box.
inject.warn.pathonly: Note: this app is neither packaged nor signed, so it can only be matched by its executable path. The match breaks if the app moves or updates into a versioned folder, and a path is not proof of identity.
keys.del_sel_confirm: Delete {0} selected entries? This cannot be undone and may require a fingerprint touch per entry.
keys.rename_prog: Renaming… (touch a fingerprint on the device if prompted)
keys.ssh.desc: ECDSA P-256; signing happens inside the device.
keys.ssh.gen: Generate a new key on-device (fingerprint required)
keys.subtitle: On-device SSH / TOTP / API keys - private keys never leave the device

msg.pair.need_connect_body:
The device is not connected, so linking cannot start.

Add and connect the immurok device in Windows Settings › Bluetooth & devices first. If it is currently connected to the other computer, disconnect it there (or move that computer out of range), then try again.
msg.pair.needsreset: The device already holds enrolled fingerprints and cannot be linked directly. Factory-reset it first: hold the device button for about 3 seconds (yellow LED after 1 s, keep holding until red). This erases all fingerprints, keys and links on the device.
msg.pair.required_banner: This PC is not linked to the device — the features on this page are unavailable.
msg.pair.required_body:
This PC is not linked to the device yet, so this feature is unavailable.

Go to the Device page and link now?
msg.pair.waitbutton: Linking timed out: the device button was not pressed within 30 seconds. Please try again.
msg.pair.waitbutton_fp: Linking timed out. The device is already linked to another computer: touch an enrolled finger first, then press the device button. If you cannot provide an enrolled fingerprint (e.g. a second-hand device), factory-reset it by holding the button for about 3 seconds (yellow LED after 1 s, keep holding until red), then try again.
msg.setup.ssh_off: Disabled. You can restore the built-in Windows ssh-agent: Set-Service ssh-agent -StartupType Manual
msg.setup.ssh_on: Enabled. If ssh/git report agent errors, make sure the built-in Windows ssh-agent is disabled: Stop-Service ssh-agent; Set-Service ssh-agent -StartupType Disabled
msg.unbind.local_only_confirm: The linked device is not connected, so it cannot be notified. This clears the local link data only — the slot on that device stays occupied until you clear it there. You can then link a new device. Continue?
msg.unbind.local_only_hint: The linked device is not connected. Unlinking will clear the local link data only; its slot on the device stays occupied until you clear it after reconnecting.
msg.unbind.local_only_ok: Local link data cleared. You can now link a new device.
msg.unbind.other_fail: Unlink failed (fingerprint rejected or timed out): {0}
msg.unbind.other_ok: The other computer has been unlinked.
msg.unbind.other_progress: Unlinking the other computer (Host {0})… touch an enrolled fingerprint on the device to confirm.
msg.unbind.rejected: The device refused to unlink: this PC is not its active host.
msg.unbind.rejected_offer: The device refused to unlink — this PC is not its active host. This usually means the local link belongs to a different device than the one now connected, so it is unusable. Clear the local link data anyway so you can link a new device?
msg.unbind.self_confirm: Unlinking this PC clears its host slot on the device and the device will restart. You will need to link again afterwards. Continue?
msg.unbind.self_ok: Unlinked this PC; the device is restarting. It also erased its Bluetooth bond and will use a new address — remove the old immurok device in Windows Bluetooth settings and add it again before reconnecting.
msg.unbind.self_progress: Unlinking this PC… the device will restart.

setup.autostart.desc: Launch immurok automatically when you sign in. Password injection runs inside this app, so if it is not running, autofill silently does nothing.
setup.autostart.fail: Could not write the registry entry; auto-start is unchanged.
setup.cp.desc: After installation, the lock screen shows the immurok fingerprint-unlock tile. Importing the registry requires administrator rights (done by the installer).
setup.pass.desc: Submitted to the system on unlock. Stored in Windows Credential Manager, never sent over BLE.
setup.pass.hint: A Microsoft account sign-in name may differ from the local username; if unlock fails, re-save the password here using your sign-in email.
setup.pass.label: Login password
setup.ssh.desc: When enabled, ssh / git sign with the device's SSH private key (each signature needs a fingerprint touch).
setup.ssh.note: Turning this on stops the built-in Windows ssh-agent and points git at the native OpenSSH; turning it off puts both back.

setup.wizard.desc: Walks through the Bluetooth connection, linking, the unlock password and your first fingerprint.
wizard.title: immurok Setup
wizard.intro: immurok is a Bluetooth fingerprint key for Windows:
wizard.feature.unlock: Unlock the lock screen with a touch
wizard.welcome.needs: Have your charged immurok device ready and keep it near this PC during setup.
wizard.welcome.time: Takes about 3 minutes. Click “Later” to stop at any time.
wizard.install.title: Install check
wizard.install.service_down: The immurok service is not running
wizard.install.service_down.hint: The background service keeps the Bluetooth connection to the device. Start it below; if it will not start, run the immurok installer again.
wizard.install.start_fail: Could not start the service. Run the immurok installer again.
wizard.install.cp_missing: The lock-screen component is not registered
wizard.install.cp_missing.hint: Without the immurok Credential Provider the lock screen cannot be unlocked with a fingerprint. Run the immurok installer again to repair it.
wizard.connect.title: Bluetooth connection
wizard.pair.title: Link This PC
wizard.pair.body: Linking is separate from the Bluetooth connection you just made: it sets up an encrypted channel so only this PC can use the device. You'll press the device button once to confirm.
wizard.password.title: Unlock password
wizard.password.body: Enter your Windows sign-in password. When your fingerprint matches, immurok enters it for you on the lock screen.
wizard.password.privacy: The password is encrypted and stored only on this PC — never on the device or the network. With a Microsoft account, use the account password, not your PIN.
wizard.fp.title: Add fingerprint
wizard.fp.body: Just like Windows Hello: lift and lightly touch the sensor again and again until the progress completes.
wizard.fp.hint: We recommend your most-used finger (index finger or thumb). You can add more later on the Fingerprint page.
wizard.complete.title: Setup complete
wizard.try.title: Try it
wizard.try.unlock: Press Win+L to lock, then touch the sensor with an enrolled finger to sign back in
wizard.tray.note: immurok keeps running in the notification area; closing the window does not quit it. It starts automatically when you sign in.
